description: Use for 'when is this hotel cheapest' (signed-in account): one hotel's nightly price by check-in date across a span of months. Needs a hotel_id from search_hotels. Then search_hotels with the chosen dates to track it.

currency.description: The traveler's currency, when they name one or their words show where they live (euros in Spain, or writing in French from Lyon). Empty: US dollars or their SlickTrip currency. Amounts you send stay US dollars.

end_month.description: Last month, as a name or YYYY-MM. Empty means next month.

hotel_name.description: The hotel's name from search_hotels, for the card's title.

start_month.description: First month, as a name or YYYY-MM. Empty means this month.

name: hotel_price_calendar

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

hotel_name.description: The hotel name as given by the caller

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

summary.description: priced_days, cheapest_per_night_usd, cheapest_check_in, median_per_night_usd, first_date, last_date

title: Hotel price calendar
